title: The Sparkless Workshop
learning_focus: Static electricity; simple circuits; conductors/insulators; electromagnet.
story_premise: The workshop loses light and its magnetic sorter stops working. The player investigates charges and rebuilds safe low-voltage models.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Static electricity; simple circuits; conductors/insulators; electromagnet.

areas.title: Static Table
areas.story: Use balloons/combs in a simulation to observe attraction after rubbing. Connect battery, wires, switch, and bulb/buzzer.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Science Guide
opening_dialogue.text: The station in Static Table is not working correctly.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Science Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Use balloons/combs in a simulation to observe attraction after rubbing.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Science Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Observe carefully, investigate Static electricity, record the evidence, and use it to restore the station.

learning_clues: Record observations and measurements before forming a conclusion.

questions.prompt: Before changing the setup, what should the learner do?

options.text: Observe the starting condition and record a prediction.
Change several things at once.
Choose a conclusion before observing.
Skip directly to the collectible.

questions.first_wrong_hint: Make a prediction from the clues already observed.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: A prediction is recorded before the investigation and is not scored as right or wrong.
questions.correct_feedback: A prediction is recorded before the investigation and is not scored as right or wrong.

questions.prompt: Which record is the strongest scientific evidence?

options.text: A direct observation or measurement from the investigation.
A guess made after seeing the answer.
A detail unrelated to the setup.
A reward animation from the game.

questions.first_wrong_hint: Evidence comes from what was observed or measured.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: Scientific evidence is a direct observation or measurement from the investigation.
questions.correct_feedback: Scientific evidence is a direct observation or measurement from the investigation.

questions.prompt: The learner should record the result before choosing a conclusion.

options.text: True
False

questions.first_wrong_hint: A conclusion must be supported by recorded evidence.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: The statement is true: results are recorded first, then used to form a conclusion.
questions.correct_feedback: The statement is true: results are recorded first, then used to form a conclusion.

areas.world_result: The scientific solution restores the station or environment in Static Table.
